test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: When is International Dance Day celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29th April**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Dance Committee of the International Theatre Institute (ITI)**, UNESCO's major partner for the performing arts, developed International Dance Day as a global celebration of dance.
 
• Every year on the 29th of April, the event commemorates the birth of Jean-Georges Noverre (1727–1810), the father of modern ballet.
 
• Through events and festivals organized on the date all across the world, the day aims to stimulate involvement and education in dance. ITI is officially recognized by UNESCO as the event's originator and organizers.
 
• Every year on April 29, the International Theatre Institute invites its members, as well as dancers, choreographers, dance students, and lovers, to a Gala Celebration to commemorate International Dance Day.
 
• The Gala Celebration is hosted in a host city chosen by the International Theatre Institute's Executive Council - for example, in 2017 it was held in Shanghai, China, and in 2018 it was held in Havana, Cuba.
